summary: The :fly pose, the softer takeoff and landing and the lit clouds are in the game; the sandbox runs at 30 fps and every plugin loads. The posted ring film is stale and shows Lumi too small to judge the pose, and I could not frame Lumi in flight myself.
surprise_why: A flying pose and a cloud ring are new but expected, and the film shows them small and far away.

findings.what: The posted 'A ring of cloud' film shows the first beaded ring (strings of identical spheres) while the game now draws 3-lump clusters. Lumi is only a few dozen pixels wide in the flight shots, so the level body and tucked legs cannot be checked on the sheet.
findings.evidence: reviews/motion/session-0075/cloud-ring-overview.jpg (bead chains, tiny Lumi). Own sandbox shots: reviews/s75-a.png (dusk, Lumi standing) and s75-b.png (11:00, lit cloud top left, the free camera did not frame the flight)
findings.suggestion: Re-render the ring film with the cluster ring and a closer side shot of takeoff, cruise and landing, then run motion_sheet on it.

findings.what: Snowflakes are still flat white discs: at 11:00 in the sandbox they show as hard round dots over the meadow. The author lists this as open in todo 438. The ring film's 16.8 h light also reads as bright afternoon, with short soft shadows.
findings.suggestion: Use soft or sprite flakes. For golden-hour films pick 17.6-18 h or warm the low sun.

findings.what: At dusk (19:06) the big pine trees have a bright green rim glow, and the whole shot is dark and murky around Lumi.
findings.suggestion: Check the rim or fringe shells at night. This may predate the session.
